topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: Orbital configurations with high elevation angles, dense satellite spacing, and adaptive beamforming justify prioritizing V-band over optical systems. Advanced modulation schemes like OFDM or QAM enhance robustness against Doppler-induced distortions, ensuring reliable links. Phased array antennas with digital beamforming mitigate atmospheric attenuation.
reference_context: Optical communications face challenges due to atmospheric phenomena, while V-band offers higher bandwidths and smaller antennas, making it suitable for certain orbital configurations.
